title: Design System: Go Media Ops Hub

figure.purpose: KPI values and the quote total; tabular figures.

table-head.purpose: Sentence-case column heads above a 2px ink rule.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on hover, focus and selection.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Rail appears; below it the rail becomes a top bar.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on a screen, e.g. Tạo báo giá, Gửi PM duyệt.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#082774; color:#fff; height:40px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:6px; font:600 14.5px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(27,26,51,.06); transition:background-color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#051A55; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #082774; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Second actions: Sao chép link, Tải PDF, Chấm điểm.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#fff; color:#1B1A33; height:40px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #E2E0D9; border-radius:6px; font:600 14.5px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(27,26,51,.06); transition:border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#66657A; background:#F4F3EF; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #082774; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height:40px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #E2E0D9; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; color:#1B1A33; font:400 15px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#66657A; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#082774; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(8,39,116,.15); }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Quote status and price tags, sentence case.
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:4px; background:#E8F3EA; color:#17652E; font:600 12px/20px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Rail Navigation Item
components.description: Item in the navy rail; active state shown.
components.html: Báo giáKho tham chiếu
components.css: .ds-rail { background:#071D57; padding:12px; width:220px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; } .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; height:40px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:6px; color:#C3CDEB; font:400 14.5px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav:hover { background:#0E2A72; color:#fff; } .ds-nav-active { background:#163A92; color:#fff; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Band Ruler
components.description: Signature: where a line's unit price sits against its library price. Orange only when the server flagged the line.
components.html: +17,2% so với thư viện
components.css: .ds-ruler { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:500 12px Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ruler-label { color:#C2410C; } .ds-ruler-scale { position:relative; width:72px; height:12px; } .ds-ruler-axis { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:50%; height:1px; background:rgba(27,26,51,.2); } .ds-ruler-centre { position:absolute; left:50%; top:0; width:1px; height:12px; background:rgba(27,26,51,.6); } .ds-ruler-run { position:absolute; left:50%; width:28.7%; top:50%; height:1px; background:#C24A00; } .ds-ruler-dot { position:absolute; left:78.7%; top:50%; width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:#C24A00; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff; }

components.name: Key Figure
components.description: KPI value under a 2px ink rule with a baseline-vs-now bar.
components.html:
Tỷ lệ báo giá quá 8 giờ
24,0%
Baseline 52,6% · Mục tiêu ≤ 30%
components.css: .ds-fig { border-top:2px solid #1B1A33; padding-top:10px; font-family:Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; width:260px; } .ds-fig-label { font:500 13px Archivo, sans-serif; color:#46455C; } .ds-fig-value { font:600 34px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.02em; color:#1B1A33; margin:4px 0; } .ds-fig-sub { font:400 13px Archivo, sans-serif; color:#66657A; }

narrative.overview: Ops Hub is set like Go Media's service rate card: a navy rail, an ivory-grey ground, white sheets ruled with hairlines and ink rules, one family with tabular figures. Orange is reserved for money and over-band prices.
keyCharacteristics: Hairlines and 2px ink rules instead of nested cards
Band ruler on every quote line

rules.name: The Money Rule
rules.body: Orange only for money totals and prices outside the band.

rules.name: No thresholds outside the CEO
rules.body: The band ruler shows deviation from the library price, never the CEO's limits.

dos: Keep UI copy unchanged when restyling
